findings.title: Q3 still lacks the committed transformations needed to recompute every reported authority value
evidence: cite: Gate 2 / R-EVD-006
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD

RESULTS_INDEX.md:48-57 names Q0_RESOLVED.md and P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md as Q3 authorities and conditions citability on a clean recomputation. Those documents report a 159-shared-atom cosine of 0.9757/0.976 and 50-80 meV alignment values.

derive_q3.py:29-72 only validates P1 convergence, P2 moment/energy, ELAS/POL energy-derived quantities, and existence/size of the two projwfc files; it does not parse per-atom weights, construct the 160-to-159 shared-atom mapping, calculate the cosine, or calculate the alignment values.

scripts/23_q0_state_metrics.py:104-116 explicitly skips cosine computation when the reference and target vectors have different lengths; committed P1 and P2 raw outputs report 160 and 159 atoms respectively. No tracked mapping or derived P1/P2 shared-atom weight record is present.

reproduce: python3 results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q3_raw/derive_q3.py && nl -ba scripts/23_q0_state_metrics.py | sed -n '104,117p' && git ls-files | rg -i 'weight.*(p1|p2)|p1.*weight|mapping|map.*(p1|p2)|shared.*atom' || true

proposed_check: C-Q3-RECOMP-002 — require the Q3 derivation to recompute every published P1/P2 cosine and alignment value from committed raw outputs plus an explicit committed 160-to-159 mapping and derived weight records; a fixture deleting or altering the mapping must fail.

findings.title: Q3 NOT CITABLE demotion is still absent from index-named authority documents
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-COR-001
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD
RESULTS_INDEX.md:36-57 marks Q3 UNVERIFIED / NOT CITABLE and names Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md, Q0_RESOLVED.md, and P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md as its authority documents.

Q0_RESOLVED.md:1-15 and P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md:72-91 retain live CBM-like/shallow-donor assertions but contain neither Q3 PROVENANCE STATUS nor UNVERIFIED/NOT CITABLE nor F-006. Therefore the canonical demotion has not reached every authority it itself names.

scripts/20_test_checks.py:987-1003 implements the correction sweep over only Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md, Q0_NEB_GATE.md, and EXPERIMENT_AUDIT.md; it omits both unmarked authorities named at RESULTS_INDEX.md:48-50, so its green result cannot demonstrate repo-wide propagation.

reproduce: for f in results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_RESOLVED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md; do if rg -n 'Q3 PROVENANCE STATUS|UNVERIFIED / NOT CITABLE|F-006' "$f"; then :; else echo "missing Q3 demotion marker: $f"; fi; done; rg -n 'Authoritative documents|Q0_RESOLVED|P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT|CBM-like|shallow-donor' RESULTS_INDEX.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_RESOLVED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md; nl -ba scripts/20_test_checks.py | sed -n '987,1003p'

proposed_check: C-SWEEP-004 — parse every authority path named by a canonical index row carrying UNVERIFIED/NOT CITABLE, require each reachable authority to carry that status or an explicit HISTORICAL/SUPERSEDED marker, and fail a fixture with the present unmarked Q0_RESOLVED.md and P1_REFERENCE_AUDIT.md.

findings.title: Current authority documents disagree on whether q0_final formally converged
evidence: cite: Gate 11 / R-STA-002
source: JUDGMENT
finding_class: HARD
Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md:131-132 states, without an historical or superseded marker, that q0_final plateaued without converging and that only the initial endpoint is relaxed.
Q0_NEB_GATE.md:8 and :22-27 assert the opposite current status: both endpoints PASS and q0_final formally CONVERGED. RESULTS_INDEX.md:23-32 likewise says both q0 endpoints formally converged.

The current raw QE output q0/q0_final_ns1.out.gz contains the formal final convergence block: Energy error 9.8E-05 Ry, Gradient error 1.6E-03 Ry/Bohr, and bfgs converged in 11 scf cycles and 10 bfgs steps.

reproduce: rg -n 'q0_final.*plateaued without converging|both q=0 endpoints genuinely ionically converged|q0_final: CONVERGED|both endpoints formally converged' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_POLARON_EXCLUDED.md results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md RESULTS_INDEX.md; gzip -cd results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/q0/q0_final_ns1.out.gz | rg 'Energy error|Gradient error|bfgs converged' | tail -3

proposed_check: C-STATE-002 — scan every current Objective 1 authority document for q0_final convergence predicates, require a single normalized state, and fail a fixture containing the unmarked plateau sentence alongside the formal QE convergence block.

summary: BLOCK: Q3 still lacks reproducible transformations for all authority values, its NOT CITABLE correction is not propagated to every named authority, and q0_final has incompatible current convergence states.

coverage.method: Enumerated all 463 tracked paths; semantically scanned all current Markdown authority/status documents and inspected the changed paths, then read and independently recomputed the Objective 1 Q3/q0 and Objective 2 primary raw/manifests/scripts in an isolated clone.
not_examined: Binary figure pixels and PDFs were inventoried but not visually rendered.
No external cluster, instrument, or remote filesystem state was available or consulted.
Historical archive documents were sampled for supersession markers rather than re-audited as current conclusions.
